title: Shifts in Your Phone Calendar
callout: Your shifts, in the calendar you already use

shots.say: Want your shifts to show up in your phone's calendar? It takes a few seconds.
shots.caption: Your shifts, in your phone's calendar

shots.say: Tap Subscribe to my shifts, and your own calendar link appears.
shots.caption: Subscribe to my shifts

shots.say: Copy the link, and add it as a subscribed calendar in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook.
shots.caption: Copy it → add to Google, Apple or Outlook

shots.say: The link is private to you. If it ever gets shared, press Reset link, and the old one stops working.
shots.caption: Private to you · Reset link if shared

shots.say: From then on, the shifts you're given show up in your calendar, and your calendar app keeps them up to date.
shots.caption: Every shift, kept up to date

shots.say: Your shifts, in the calendar you already use.
shots.caption: The calendar you already use
